records.jp: 子供の頃ってさ、SFアニメに影響受けて<CR>宇宙飛行士に憧れたりするよねー
records.en_original: I think every kid wants to be an astronaut when they grow up.
records.en: I think every kid wants to be an astronaut when they grow up.

records.jp: でも、頭も運動神経も良くないとダメって知って<CR>あ、こりゃ無理だなーってなるわけですよ
records.en_original: But most people give up when they realize you have to be both brainy and sporty to do so.
records.en: But most people give up when they realize you have to be both brainy and sporty to do so.

records.jp: 愛央……身長いくつ？
records.en_original: How tall are you, Ao?
records.en: How tall are you, Ao?

records.jp: え？　１５７センチだけど？
records.en_original: Huh? Like 157 centimeters?
records.en: Huh? Like 157 centimeters?

records.jp: 宇宙服のサイズが限られてるから、<CR>宇宙飛行士になるには身長も必要
records.en_original: Apparently space suits can only made in certain sizes, so your height is important as well.
records.en: Apparently space suits can only made in certain sizes, so your height is important as well.

records.jp: あ、なんか漫画で読んだことあるかも。<CR>１５０前後の人って、難しいんだよね
records.en_original: Ooh, I think I read in a manga that it's hard for people under 150 centimeters to become astronauts.
records.en: Ooh, I think I read in a manga that it's hard for people under 150 centimeters to become astronauts.

records.jp: きらら、<CR>１４７センチですが、何か？
records.en_original: I'm 147. Choose your next words carefully.
records.en: Kirara is 147 centimeters tall. Is there a problem?

records.jp: えーと……
records.en_original: Uhh...
records.en: Uhh...

records.jp: 小さくて可愛いと思う！
records.en_original: You're so little and cute!
records.en: You're so little and cute!

records.jp: 愛央は、きららより大きいけど可愛い
records.en_original: You may be taller, but I think you're cute as well.
records.en: You're taller than Kirara, Ao, but you're cute.

records.jp: えっ、あ、ありがとう……？
records.en_original: Huh? Th-thank you...?
records.en: Huh? Th-thank you...?

records.jp: うん。どういたしまして
records.en_original: You're quite welcome.
records.en: You're quite welcome.

records.jp: （サラリと、褒め返された……）
records.en_original: (She turned that around fast...)
records.en: (She turned that around fast...)

records.jp: これから伸びるよ！
records.en_original: Don't worry, you'll still grow!
records.en: Don't worry, you'll still grow!

records.jp: そう思い続けて、はや数年……<CR>これが、その結果ですが、何か？
records.en_original: I've been telling myself that for years, and I haven't grown at all.
records.en: I've been telling myself that for years, and I haven't grown at all.

records.jp: なんか、ごめん……
records.en_original: Oh... Sorry...
records.en: Oh... Sorry...

records.jp: 許す
records.en_original: You are forgiven.
records.en: You are forgiven.

records.jp: でも、きららは宇宙飛行士になりたいわけじゃ<CR>ないから別に、今のままでいい
records.en_original: Of course, I don't particularly want to become an astronaut. I'm fine with the way I am.
records.en: But Kirara doesn't want to be an astronaut, so Kirara is fine as she is.

records.jp: んじゃ、何になりたいの？
records.en_original: What do you want to be?
records.en: What do you want to be?

records.jp: 分からない。考えたことなかった
records.en_original: I don't know. I haven't given it much thought.
records.en: I don't know. I haven't given it much thought.

records.jp: 愛央は？
records.en_original: You, Ao?
records.en: You, Ao?

records.jp: やっぱり、可愛いお嫁さんかな！
records.en_original: I know! A cute, loving housewife!
records.en: I know! A cute, loving housewife!

records.jp: 可愛いお嫁さん……
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: あはは、やっぱ似合わないかな？
records.en_original: Ahaha, is that weird?
records.en: Ahaha, is that weird?

records.jp: そんなことない。<CR>可愛いは問題ない、でも……
records.en_original: Not at all. You have the cute part down. However...
records.en: Not at all. You have the cute part down. However...

records.jp: お嫁さんだけなのは、<CR>なんだかもったいない気がする
records.en_original: It just seems like it would be a waste.
records.en: It just seems like it would be a waste.

records.jp: そんなことないって。主婦業だって<CR>ちゃんとできるか分かんないしね
records.en_original: Really? I mean, I don't even know if I'd be any good at all that domestic stuff.
records.en: Really? I mean, I don't even know if I'd be any good at all that domestic stuff.

records.jp: ……いや、そもそも。旦那様が<CR>見つかるのかって話か……
records.en_original: Wait, I should be worrying about if I'll ever even be able to find a husband first.
records.en: Wait, I should be worrying about if I'll ever even be able to find a husband first.

records.jp: 貰い手がなかったら<CR>きららのところに来ればいい
records.en_original: I'll gladly take you if no one else will.
records.en: If no one else will take you, come to Kirara.

records.jp: まじで！？　ありがとう、きらら！
records.en_original: Really?! Thanks a bunch, Kirara!
records.en: Really?! Thanks a bunch, Kirara!

records.jp: 私は、これから探すつもり！
records.en_original: I don't know yet, but I'll find out one day!
records.en: I don't know yet, but I'll find out one day!

records.jp: これから……
records.en_original: One day?
records.en: One day?

records.jp: そう。今はまだ<CR>いろいろ試してるところかなー？
records.en_original: Yeah. I won't know what's good for me if I don't try out a lot of things first.
records.en: Yeah. I won't know what's good for me if I don't try out a lot of things first.

records.jp: 好きなものも、楽しいものも<CR>たくさんあるからね
records.en_original: I mean, I have so many things I like doing.
records.en: I mean, I have so many things I like doing.

records.jp: どれかひとつなんて、まだ決められないよ
records.en_original: I can't pick just one thing!
records.en: I can't pick just one thing!

records.jp: まあ……決めるだけの才能が<CR>自分にないって言うのもあるけど
records.en_original: I always thought the only thing I was good at was being decisive... Guess that's not true.
records.en: I always thought the only thing I was good at was being decisive... Guess that's not true.

records.jp: そんなことない。愛央はすごい。<CR>いつも、みんなの中心にいる
records.en_original: Not at all. I think you're amazing. You're our group's heart.
records.en: Not at all. I think you're amazing. You're our group's heart.

records.jp: それも、才能だと思う。<CR>きららにはできないことだから
records.en_original: That is talent too. I would never be able to be that.
records.en: Kirara thinks that's a talent too. It's something Kirara can't do.

records.jp: あはは、ありがとう。でも、私なんて<CR>みんなに比べたら普通だからなー
records.en_original: Ahaha, thanks. But compared to everyone else, I'm just...normal.
records.en: Ahaha, thanks. But compared to everyone else, I'm just...normal.

records.jp: いつか……きららが言うみたいに、<CR>特別な才能とか芽生えたらいいんだけどね
records.en_original: Maybe I'll find a special talent of my own like you said.
records.en: Maybe I'll find a special talent of my own like you said.

records.jp: ……愛央。<CR>きららは、何になれると思う？<CR>
records.en_original: ...Ao? What do you think I should become?
records.en: ...Ao. What do you think Kirara can become?

records.jp: うーん、そうだなぁ……
records.en_original: Hmm, lets see...
records.en: Hmm, lets see...

records.jp: やっぱり、占い師とか？
records.en_original: I know! A fortune teller!
records.en: I know! A fortune teller!

records.jp: きららの言葉って、なんか説得力あるし<CR>向いてると思うけど
records.en_original: Everything you say sounds so convincing. I think you'd do great.
records.en: Everything you say sounds so convincing. I think you'd do great.

records.jp: でも、きらら……<CR>もう神様の声が聞こえないかもしれない
records.en_original: But... I may never be able to hear the Divine again.
records.en: But Kirara... may no longer be able to hear the Divine's voice.

records.jp: タロット占いとか、水晶占いとかできないの？
records.en_original: Can you use tarot cards? Or a crystal ball?
records.en: Can you use tarot cards? Or a crystal ball?

records.jp: できない
records.en_original: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: まじか！<CR>めっちゃできそうなのに！
records.en_original: No way! I totally thought you'd be able to!
records.en: No way! I totally thought you'd be able to!

records.jp: あ……手相なら少し分かる
records.en_original: Ah... I have some experience in palmistry.
records.en: Ah... I have some experience in palmistry.

records.jp: おお、いいじゃん！<CR>私の手相どう？
records.en_original: That's perfect! Ooh, read mine!
records.en: That's perfect! Ooh, read mine!

records.jp: （手をにぎにぎされてるけど……<CR>これって、手相？）
records.en_original: (Seems like she's just squeezing my hand... Is she really reading my palm?)
records.en: (Seems like she's just squeezing my hand... Is she really reading my palm?)

records.jp: わかりました。愛央は……
records.en_original: I'm finished. Let me tell you what I found...
records.en: I'm finished. Let me tell you what I found...

records.jp: 愛央は！？
records.en_original: Yes?!
records.en: What about Ao?!

records.jp: 胃がちょっと荒れていますね。<CR>間食は控えたほうが良いでしょう
records.en_original: You seem to be having some stomach problems. I would recommend you refrain from excessive snacking.
records.en: You seem to be having some stomach problems. I would recommend you refrain from excessive snacking.

records.jp: いや、これ診察！！
records.en_original: That's not palmistry, that's reflexology!
records.en: That's not palmistry, that's reflexology!

records.jp: うーん、小説家とか？
records.en_original: How about an author?
records.en: How about an author?

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: For what reason?
records.en: For what reason?

records.jp: きららっていろんなこと知ってるし<CR>いろんな経験もしてるでしょ？
records.en_original: Well, you know a lot. And you have a lot of life experience.
records.en: Well, you know a lot. And you have a lot of life experience.

records.jp: そこから生まれる物語って<CR>なんか面白そうだなーと思ってさ
records.en_original: I thought your experiences would make an interesting basis for a story.
records.en: I thought your experiences would make an interesting basis for a story.

records.jp: ……同人誌なら書いたことある
records.en_original: I do have some experience writing some...fan fiction.
records.en: I do have some experience writing some...fan fiction.

records.jp: え、なに？
records.en_original: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: なんでもない
records.en_original: Nothing.
records.en: Nothing.

records.jp: 今「同人誌」って聞こえましたけど！？
records.en_original: You said fan fiction right? What do you mean fan fiction?!
records.en: You said fan fiction right? What do you mean fan fiction?!

records.jp: あ、神様がきららを呼んでいる
records.en_original: It seems the Divine is calling me, I must take my leave.
records.en: Ah, the Divine is calling Kirara.

records.jp: 都合が悪くなると、神様に逃げるの禁止！！
records.en_original: Hey, you can't use that as an excuse just when it's convenient!
records.en: Hey, you can't use that as an excuse just when it's convenient!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
